name: Queue sweep
description: Seven documents through one queue, grouped to save paper: most jobs change more than one option, so a wrong sheet is compared against its own description rather than the job before it. The pages.pdf jobs are the ones that prove the raster path: on an IPP printer that does not read PDF they are rendered here and sent as PWG Raster, and every fault that path can have is visible on the sheet.

jobs.description: a PDF with the printer defaults
a PNG in colour, at its own size
a PNG in grayscale, rotated 90 degrees
a JPEG rotated 180 degrees, in grayscale, filling the media
four pages in colour, to check the raster geometry
pages 1 and 3 in grayscale, which is one octet a pixel instead of three, duplex on the short edge: one sheet, turning like a flip pad
pages 2 and 4, selected by the converter and not by the printer, duplex on the long edge: one sheet, turning like a book
